description:
Get comprehensive disease annotations from Open Targets.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table disease — one record = one ontology term used by Open Targets as a disease, phenotype, measurement or process.
Key: id.
Arguments: disease_id accepts ot disease or disease name (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Disease, phenotype and measurement terms of OT 25.09 (EFO/MONDO and imported ontologies).

disease_id.description: Accepts ot_disease, disease_name; resolved to one ot_disease (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
